## Frozen qualification

Before timing, all current arguments, schema, persistence, exit and overwrite preflights must pass at a committed head with workload launches 0. Read-only environment assessment may choose readiness but cannot spend workload invocations. Exactly one controlled runner invocation is authorized; do not use the uncontrolled escape hatch. Preserve invocation/process/warmup/round counts and all raw/disposition data. Success requires the expected 46 records, unchanged current complete record and aggregate validators, and exact provenance. Missing cycle data stays null, never inferred. Report idle/console/ragged/mono rows and structural/output identities with candid host/workload comparability limits; no promised speedup or timing-based tuning.

A failure after launch preserves raw output and stops; runner defects go to separately scoped tooling. A prelaunch refusal also consumes this successor's frozen invocation and leaves measurement unresolved for an explicit later scheduling/ruling decision. There is no automatic retry or chain of replacement successors. No benchmark has run under this issue merely because it is created.
